result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password or Bitwarden**\.

My overall recommendation is **1Password if ease of use and team collaboration matter most; Bitwarden if keeping costs down is the priority.**

Here's how I'd compare the leading options.

## Best password managers for small teams

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password Business**

(Best overall experience)

# \$8.99

Per user/month, annual billing

- Excellent shared vaults and permissions
- Easy for nontechnical employees
- Strong admin controls and reporting
- Good onboarding and offboarding

Best for teams that want something polished and easy to manage.

[1Password Business website](https://1password.com/business)

---

![Free High-Quality Bitwarden Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/p0IJzf2NCUQ2t02rqtPWDpe7Tx4YGCRNleASv1NjpztaDI--7OD-0zWJhdBi_4Wn4-v0Hr3hoS6JA2KXHdCOlvvdfHelZm6tTBmFuxgAbBftLkdqobRCpEkp4ysyI4Rm6vafJPMfHi8ri9Tdeng_QKXRw7C7a5ESA6hn8XLhRMLnvM7oFmwZESsO4_SFLJaX?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden Teams**

(Best value)

# \$4

Per user/month, annual billing

- Open-source foundation
- Shared collections and team access
- Event and audit logs
- Directory integration

Best for budget-conscious teams, particularly those with technical staff.

[Bitwarden Business website](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

# \$2–4

Per user/month, depending on plan

- Centralized administration
- Shared team folders
- Strong security and compliance features
- Additional security products available

Best for teams wanting centralized security management.

[Keeper Business website](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![Test Dashlane : un gestionnaire de mots de passe élégant et complet, mais trop avare - Les Numériques](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/66TJUMmYmc2uHzIsxHHiAx7hxRQ8alP8a248IQqZpKMw5qyY_k9MeFr4rutufsLjTYxUl32XmJycQKSNVtCaRTxRhBdFKuuN8SD7uZ8vs9JkSCZSzdZ2yIQm88TGjWCrg-h07fJdRP7X6VdOalsZe2e6fj_Ou1dMYyLIEbt_d4hajtzL8hVlKJz2qWk0Hm2z?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Dashlane**

- Password health monitoring
- Phishing protection features
- Centralized administration
- Security alerts and reporting

Best for organizations wanting additional credential-risk monitoring.

[Dashlane Business website](https://www.dashlane.com/business)

Pricing is based on published November 2026 comparisons; confirm current plan details before purchasing. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-password-manager-for-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[vettlo.com](https://vettlo.com/tools/best-password-managers-for-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My comparison

| Feature | 1Password | Bitwarden | Keeper |
|--------|--------|--------|--------|
| Ease of use | Excellent | Very good | Very good |
| Shared passwords | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Admin controls | Excellent | Very good | Excellent |
| Audit logs | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Budget-friendly | Moderate | Excellent | Excellent |
| Best fit | General teams | Technical teams | Security-focused teams |


## What I'd prioritize

Regardless of which product you choose, make sure it supports\:

1. **Shared vaults\:** Employees can access company credentials without sharing passwords through email or Slack.
2. **Individual accounts\:** Every employee has their own login.
3. **Role-based permissions\:** Finance, IT, HR, and management can have separate access.
4. **Offboarding\:** Quickly revoke access when someone leaves.
5. **MFA\:** Require multifactor authentication for everyone.
6. **Audit logs\:** See who accessed or changed shared credentials.

## A couple of questions to narrow it down

I can make a much more specific recommendation with two details\:

**1\. How many people are on your team?**

---

**2\. What's most important?**

---

**3\. What does your company primarily use?**

[Get my recommendation]

I'll use those details to recommend the best product and the actual plan I'd purchase, rather than paying for unnecessary enterprise features.
